title: polyphlebium vieillardii
intro: Polyphlebium vieillardii, commonly known as the Vieillard's polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic. The Vieillard's polypody is reported to have therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
